claims.assertion: Ari says Urmah remain near Earth to monitor Urmah starseeds and escort Toleka under cooperation treaties; they suspect the Federation mismanages Earth.
claims.speaker: Ari (Arishah), Urmah communications officer
claims.qualifiers: Ari presents these as Urmah motives and suspicions.

claims.assertion: Ari claims Earth was fifth density before the Tiamat wars; the Federation trapped surviving enemies there, creating a low-frequency realm that feeds lower-astral entities.
claims.speaker: Ari (Arishah), Urmah communications officer
claims.qualifiers: The account is attributed to the Urmah.

claims.assertion: Ari says Urmah prefer diplomacy but use overwhelming military force when necessary; their presence near Earth is intended to deter Federation actions.
claims.speaker: Ari (Arishah), Urmah communications officer

coverage_gaps: Urmah-Federation history and false-invasion claims omitted
